label: TP
reason: User input from cookies flows directly into the LDAP filter string via doSomething, which performs Base64 encode/decode round-trip (effectively identity transformation), then concatenates into the LDAP filter used in ctx.search(). The ESAPI encoder only protects attribute display, not the filter construction itself. This enables LDAP injection via special characters in the decoded payload.

evidence.note: Cookie value flows through decode -> doSanitize (identity) -> filter construction -> LDAP search sink
